lt.compact_width_hint:
Requested width of the compact bar. Capped to the experience-bar width, so it
never extends past the XP bar regardless of this value.
lt.history_size_hint: Completed-map rows kept in the session history (table + memory); oldest dropped past this.
lt.offset_bottom_hint:
Distance the bars sit up from the bottom of the game window. Raise it until
they clear the experience bar / skill bar at your resolution and UI scale.
lt.ui_scale_hint:
Manual multiplier on top of the automatic game-UI scale (window height / 1600).
Font and fixed widths scale with it, so the bars match the HUD across resolutions.
lt.show_kills_hint: Per-rarity monsters slain this run (Normal · Magic · Rare · Unique).
lt.show_toasts_hint:
A brief toast (item name + value) above the map strip when you pick an item up.
Up to 3 at once; same-item pickups merge. Only while actively on a map.
lt.notify_min_hint: Only pickups worth at least this many Exalted toast. Unpriced items never toast.
lt.divine_only: Detailed history and notifications in Divine
lt.divine_only_hint: Applies to loot details, saved sessions and notifications. Currency buttons control the tracker panel.
lt.sessions_keep_hint: Older sessions are deleted once this many are stored. A session is saved on "New session".
lt.league_hint: Prices are fetched for exactly this poe.ninja league.
lt.custom_league_hint:
Enter poe.ninja's API name, with spaces ("Runes of Aldur") — not the web slug
("runesofaldur"), which the API answers with an empty result.
lt.league_adopted: League "{0}" is gone from poe.ninja; switched to "{1}".
lt.status_zero_rows:
poe.ninja answered, but has no rows for this league. Check the league name: it must be
the API name with spaces ("Runes of Aldur"), not the web slug ("runesofaldur").
lt.no_maps: No maps completed yet this session.
lt.separate_hint: Drag the window title bar to any monitor. Its position and size are saved.
lt.free_position: Free position on the game screen
lt.move_hint: Unlock, close the settings menu, then drag the LootTracker title bar. Lock it again when done.
lt.window_error: The independent window could not open. The display has returned to the game screen.
lt.currencies_hint: Select the values to display together:
lt.rate_missing: Market rate unavailable. Refresh prices in LootTracker settings.
lt.rate_missing_hint: — means the conversion rate is unavailable.
lt.conversion_hint: Equivalent values using cached market prices; amounts are not added together.
